note: The interlude jingle's CLOCK (queue-manager.js §13; NE-31j): it rides the seam beat's machinery — starts at the boundary, absorbs the next load, holds playback until it ends or the INTERLUDE_CEILING_SEC ceiling cuts it, and dies with the beat on any transport action. The RULE (which seams get one) is the interlude family's. Port card NE-31s.

covers: queue-manager::segment -> segment: the jingle starts at the boundary, the next load runs under it, and playback waits for it
cases.note: It starts at the out-point, the next load runs under it, the beat alone does not release it, and the tape starts when it ends.

covers: queue-manager::never before the first item: pressing play starts the tape, not a jingle
cases.note: There is nothing to mark off from.

covers: queue-manager::narration -> segment gets the jingle after the line; segment -> narration does not
cases.note: Narration is the marker into narration; the jingle sounds between the narrator's line and the tape.

covers: queue-manager::never between two narration items: a narration chain gets one jingle, into the tape
cases.note: Narration -> narration: none; narration -> segment: exactly one.

covers: queue-manager::never after the last item: the Foray simply ends
cases.note: The Foray ends; nothing sounds after it.

covers: queue-manager::the jingle is not a queue item: the queue, the runtime and the index are what the Foray authored
cases.note: Three authored segments are three queue items; the jingle plays at the seam and the index moves by exactly one.

covers: queue-manager::pause during the jingle silences it, nothing starts, and no position is written for it
cases.note: Pause cuts the jingle like it cuts the beat; nothing becomes audible after it and no position is written.

covers: queue-manager::next during the jingle silences it, and a skip gets no jingle of its own (the listener named a destination)
cases.note: The skip cuts the jingle, starts no second one, and lands on the third segment.

covers: queue-manager::a jingle that cannot start leaves the seam its ordinary beat
cases.note: Refused: the seam is the 0.5 s beat and only the beat.

covers: queue-manager::a jingle that ends early still spends the beat
cases.note: Dead 200 ms in, the beat still owes 300 ms.

covers: queue-manager::a jingle that never reports ending is cut at the ceiling and the tape starts
cases.note: INTERLUDE_CEILING_SEC (4.5 s) from the out-point: the jingle is cut and the tape starts, never two things audible at once.

covers: queue-manager::interludeEnabled: false plays no jingle; setInterludeEnabled(true) turns it on for the next seam
cases.note: Off means off; turned on, the next seam has it.

covers: queue-manager::with no interlude wired, every seam is exactly what it was
cases.note: Without a jingle player the seam is the beat.

covers: queue-manager::dispose() during a jingle silences it and releases the element
cases.note: The teardown cuts the jingle and drops its buffer.

covers: queue-manager::pause while the next segment is still loading cuts the jingle at once, not when the load lands
cases.note: Cut at the tap while the load is in flight; the load landing into a paused player starts nothing.
